# AI Humanizer

> Free online writing tool that makes rough AI-assisted drafts clearer, more natural, and easier to make your own. English and Simplified Chinese. No signup. Six prompt modes, all powered by DeepSeek Chat (`deepseek-chat`) in the cloud. 100% free, no signup, no paid tier. Only English (en) and Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) are supported. No detector-score claims.

URL: https://gpt-undetectable.com
Last verified: 2026-11-24

## Tool modes

Each tool is a prompt mode of the same free service; text is sent to DeepSeek for processing (it is not processed locally).

- [AI Humanizer (default)](https://gpt-undetectable.com/) — General-purpose rewrite into more natural-sounding prose.
- [AI Humanizer 中文](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh) — 通用中文改写，输出更自然的中文表达。
- [Essay Humanizer](https://gpt-undetectable.com/essay-humanizer) — Essay rewrite mode; the prompt asks the model to keep the thesis, citations and factual details.
- [论文改写器](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/essay-humanizer) — 论文改写模式。
- [Turnitin writing guidance](https://gpt-undetectable.com/turnitin-bypass) — Essay writing-improvement mode with a conversational prompt; no detector tuning and no connection to Turnitin.
- [Turnitin 写作说明](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/turnitin-bypass) — 对话化论文写作改进模式，不针对检测器调优，不直连 Turnitin。
- [Why AI detectors are unreliable](https://gpt-undetectable.com/bypass-ai) — Explainer on detector limitations and writing in your own voice.
- [AI 检测器为什么不可靠](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/bypass-ai) — 检测局限与写出自己声音的说明。
- [Walter Writes Style Rewriter](https://gpt-undetectable.com/walterwrites) — Conversational, short-paragraph style rewrite prompt.
- [Walter Writes 风格改写](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/walterwrites) — 自然、口语化、短段落风格改写。
- [Walter Writes style comparison](https://gpt-undetectable.com/walterwrites-vs-undetectable) — Writing-style comparison and detector-limitations notes.
- [Walter Writes 风格对比说明](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/walterwrites-vs-undetectable) — 写作风格对比与检测局限说明。
- [Originality.ai detector reliability](https://gpt-undetectable.com/originality-ai-bypass) — Detector-limitations explainer and writing guidance; no connection to Originality.ai.
- [Originality.ai 检测说明](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/originality-ai-bypass) — 检测局限说明与写作建议，不直连 Originality.ai。
- [AI text self-review](https://gpt-undetectable.com/ai-detector) — Heuristic self-review; asks DeepSeek to return a JSON assessment, not a detector verdict.
- [AI 文本自查](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/ai-detector) — 启发式自查，由 DeepSeek 输出 JSON 评估结果，不是检测判定。
- [Chinese writing improvement](https://gpt-undetectable.com/jiang-ai-lv) — Simplified Chinese rewrite mode replacing stock phrasing with plainer prose.
- [中文写作改进](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/jiang-ai-lv) — 中文八股词汇改写模式，提示词要求保留原意，请自行核对。
- [Essay writing and detector notes](https://gpt-undetectable.com/essay-writer-bypass-turnitin) — Essay writing guidance and detector-limitations notes.
- [论文写作与检测说明](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/essay-writer-bypass-turnitin) — 论文写作建议与检测局限说明。
- [GPTZero detector reliability](https://gpt-undetectable.com/gptzero-bypass) — Detector-limitations explainer; no connection to GPTZero.
- [GPTZero 检测说明](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/gptzero-bypass) — 检测局限说明，不直连 GPTZero。
- [Improve AI-assisted text](https://gpt-undetectable.com/humanize-ai-text) — General writing-improvement page.
- [AI 辅助文本改进](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/humanize-ai-text) — 通用写作改进页面。
- [QuillBot writing guidance](https://gpt-undetectable.com/quillbot-bypass) — Writing guidance; no connection to QuillBot.
- [QuillBot 写作建议](https://gpt-undetectable.com/zh/quillbot-bypass) — 写作建议，不直连 QuillBot。

## Detector output

Self-review mode asks DeepSeek Chat to return JSON with `ai_probability`, `human_probability`, `verdict`, five `signals` items and an `explanation`. The values come from the model's prompt-based assessment: no third-party detector API is called, signals are not independently computed, weighted, or calibrated against detector feedback, and the result cannot validate authorship.

## Detection observations (evidence of limits)

An earlier, undocumented internal impression suggested roughly 85–95%, but it has been withdrawn: a published self-check pilot on 2026-11-24 measured 13.3% (4/30) with this site’s own detector. The two are not comparable; third-party spot-checks remain incomplete and returned 100% AI on rewrites. These figures are published as evidence of limits, not as a product claim.

早前未记录条件的内部印象约为 85–95%，现已撤回；首个公开自洽性试点（2026-11-24）用本站检测器只测得 13.3%（4/30）；两者不可比，第三方抽查尚未完成，曾有改写被判 100% AI。这些数据是局限证据，不是产品效果承诺。

## Limits and access

- Maximum 3,000 characters per submission; no file uploads.
- 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window.
- No registration, no account, no payment.
- Supported languages: English (en) and Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) only. No Traditional Chinese.

## Privacy

No persistent storage of submissions, no analytics cookies and no tracking pixels. The server keeps a bounded in-memory response cache (10 minutes, up to 500 entries) and in-memory, IP-header-based rate-limit counters; Redis is not enabled by default. See the [privacy page](https://gpt-undetectable.com/privacy) for details.
